verdict.rationale: Temporal's docs describe Schedules as a first-class primitive that starts Workflow Executions at specific times, and position them as a more flexible replacement for its Cron Jobs, which are also listed as a workflow feature. Together these deliver recurring, scheduled workflows. Missing for 10: detail on recurrence specs (intervals/calendar expressions, pause/backfill management) and independent hands-on corroboration of Schedules specifically.
